settings.teams.roleIdInvalid: Use a lowercase slug (letters, digits, _ or -).

error.team.unknownMember: That member is not on this team.
error.team.kickLocal: Cannot kick this machine from its own team.
error.team.badRoles: Those roles are not valid for this team.
error.job.stepsLocked: Steps can only be edited while the job is drafting or running.
error.job.writerLock: Two implement steps share worktree key “{key}”.
error.job.notRunning: The job is not in a state that accepts this action.
error.job.noSteps: Add at least one step before starting.
error.job.noCandidate: No online machine offers role “{role}”. Fix the team, then try Start again.
error.job.notDrafting: Only a drafting job can be started.
error.job.stepsInFlight: Cannot replace steps that are already in progress. Pause the job first, or edit only pending steps.
job.pane.teamStatusFailed: Could not refresh the team board. Start may be wrong until this succeeds.
job.pane.suggestOnlyDraft: Suggest steps only while the job is drafting (pause first if it is running).
error.job.offerClosed: That offer is no longer pending.
error.job.pathMissing: That folder is missing on this machine. Clone the project and open it, then try again.
error.job.git.notARepo: That folder is not a Git repository. Team jobs share work through Git — initialize or clone a repo.
error.job.git.noRemote: This Git repository has no remote. Add origin (or another remote) so teammates can pull and push.
error.job.git.missing: Git is not installed (or not on PATH) on this machine. Install Git before accepting a Team job step.
teamJob.git.ok: Git ready — repository with a remote.

teamJob.git.noRemote: Add a Git remote (e.g. origin) before starting a Team job.
teamJob.git.missing: Git is not available on this machine.
job.pane.crew.gitBlocked: Fix Git on this project before starting (repo + remote).
